name: 黑白双色圆领印花短袖T恤款
description: 宽松圆领微弹不变形、双车线领口、后背经典印花、黑白双色透气短袖

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, light warm grey #D8D5D2 for lifestyle and variant screens, one deep navy #2B3245 closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows; natural 5500K window light for lifestyle shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio backdrop and matte light-grey board #EDEBE8 for detail flat-lays
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, black rectangular label tags with white text as the recurring label device
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line care/attribute icons and rounded rectangular info labels, single near-black #1F1F1F line color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set; variants and comparison shots reuse the identical hero angle and lighting
styleLock.lockText: consistent youthful casual menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light warm grey #D8D5D2, deep navy accent #2B3245 and near-black text #1F1F1F; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent black rectangular label tags with white text plus thin-line icons; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; compositions filled by the garment and its supporting copy blocks; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底款

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shown at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, presented on an invisible mannequin form so the relaxed silhouette and crew neckline read clearly. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. provenance.notes: 源图仅 6 屏（首屏模特海报、产品参数与尺码表、双色款式、细节展示、模特展示墙、会员二维码收尾），按漏斗惯例补足到 8 镜：新增痛点对比镜（源自图内「圆领微弹不变形」卖点）与 CTA 收口镜；补足镜未编造源图没有的规格或卖点。面料成分百分比（棉96%）、尺码数值等不可验证或原文数据一律以卖点占位符承接、由商家回填。已剥离模特面容与身份、店铺会员二维码与促销贴、原文案与黑底标签排版，模特统一为通用化描述。
